requirement (exact wording, LLMREI requi: FR: An online system with options for reservation and booking shall be implemented.

FR: The centralized system should be able to generate reports for reservations, payments, inventory, and other business aspects.

NFR: The website shall offer a pleasing and intuitive website for customers to see availabilities in the resorts.
BR: The system should help the business increase ist visibility across. the US and attract more customers.
BR: The system should reduce manual coordination and streamline tasks such as booking, payments, and inventory tracking.
